children: Livestock futures on the CME rise, with sharply lower grain futures providing support, says the Hightower Report in a note. However, it's whether the higher start can last the rest of the session that analysts are looking for. "The recent trend of selling on intraday rallies is a headwind and if the market does break through yesterday's low, a new leg lower may begin," says the firm. Cattle is up 0.8%, while hogs are now flat after a higher start in the opening minutes of trading.(kirk.maltais@wsj.com)
